source: Owner direct chat after MSQ-88 handoff and discussion of reactive balance-recovery steps
owner_feature_question_original: А еще вопрос, сейчас у нас есть реакция на попадание, мне нравится. А нельзя ли сделать что бы маникен как бы оступал чуть назад относительно направления урона по нему, пытаясь при этом сохранить баланс на ногах?
decision: Create one planning-only follow-up for short reactive steps that attempt to preserve standing balance after hits, extending the current hit response.
discussed_proposal: One or two short recovery steps selected from actual body displacement/lean and hit impulse, with support-leg choice, foot placement and retained physical collapse when disturbance or support loss exceeds recovery. Tunable lengths, durations and thresholds are implementation proposals rather than approved numeric values.
baseline: MSQ-88 Candidate04, closure commit c618623. The owner positively evaluates the current appearance and likes the hit reaction. Preserve that experimental baseline and all original evidence; this feedback does not claim unrestricted tangled-pose or final-character-art acceptance.
authorization: Task creation and project planning records only. No executor assignment, implementation run, editor mutation, independent checks, task-runtime startup or automatic successor dispatch.
review_context: The owner's earlier MSQ-88 execution waived independent checks. No checker is requested or dispatched by this planning request. Final motion judgement stays with the owner; follow applicable owner direction at a future explicit execution start without turning a scoped waiver into a universal rule.
preservation: Retain current reactions, six independent mannequins, self-collision, sole grounding, snapshot get-up, source animations, damage/death/reset semantics, relative slowdown, optional combat toggles, purchased arms, lobby, owner files and application sessions.
exclusions: No general locomotion/AI/navigation overhaul, Mover migration, full push or explosion ability, new art, animation purchase, paid service, lobby editing or successor start. The separate question about convenient get-up clip replacement is not execution scope for this task.
